name: Arizona

rule.textEn: Arizona has no general boater education requirement; a course is only mandatory when a court orders it after a boating citation. The state offers free courses.
rule.textEs: Arizona no tiene un requisito general de educación náutica; el curso solo es obligatorio cuando un juez lo ordena tras una multa. El estado ofrece cursos gratuitos.

card.feeNote: AZGFD offers a free home study packet and classes.

sources.publisher: Arizona Game and Fish Department (archived copy of 2026-04-07; live page answers 403 to scripts)
sources.quote: Need to complete a boating safety education course because of a boating ticket? Choose an option below to meet the court’s requirements.
Fill out the Home Study Packet Request Form or email [email protected] to get your free home study packet.

uncertain: required (no explicit official sentence saying no requirement; AZGFD only describes court-ordered and voluntary courses)
